title: License/PII/sensitivity policy + non-destructive & reproducibility charter
context: This governance charter locks the project's non-negotiable constraints in writing before any real data is processed. It is the authority the mandatory license/PII/sensitivity reviewer applies to every source and every packaged output. It must encode the accepted-source-license allowlist, the privacy fail-closed stance, per-record license tracking, and the no-PII/sensitive-data-in-repo rule. Depends on csp-repo-001.
objective: Write the committed license/PII/sensitivity policy plus the non-destructive and reproducibility charter, including a reviewable gate checklist applied to every source.
acceptanceCriteria: Enumerates accepted source licenses (CC0/CC-BY/PD/open-gov; ODbL with share-alike honored; CC-BY-NC under the NC policy) and exclusions (no clear license; restricted-terms platforms; no scraping)
States the non-destructive, reproducibility, and privacy fail-closed invariants and the no-PII/sensitive-data-in-repo rule
Defines the per-record license-tracking and most-restrictive-governs-packaged-output rule
Provides a reviewable license/PII/sensitivity gate checklist applied to every source and every packaged output
